roadmap.title: Human campaign, mission objectives, and collectibles
roadmap.description: Clear NERO/DANTE/V GAME on Human while completing mission-specific objectives, discovering all 12 Secret Missions, collecting Blue and Purple Orb fragments, and securing the playable-credits ending.

roadmap.title: Difficulty ladder and S ranks
roadmap.description: Clear Devil Hunter, Son of Sparda, Dante Must Die, Heaven or Hell, and Hell and Hell separately. Record S ranks across the five required difficulties and use Irregular Full Custom for Dante's weaponless Mission 11.

roadmap.title: Combat, skills, and cumulative cleanup
roadmap.description: Farm Red Orbs, purchase every base-character skill, finish style and cumulative counters, and clean up the remaining character-restricted mission challenges.

roadmap.title: Bloody Palace with the base cast
roadmap.description: Clear all 101 Bloody Palace floors separately as Nero, Dante, and V; Super costumes are allowed for these completion achievements.

roadmap.title: Vergil Game and Bloody Palace
roadmap.description: With the Playable Character: Vergil DLC, clear Vergil's campaign, purchase every Vergil skill, finish Mission 19 with Yamato only, and clear Bloody Palace as Vergil.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Human mode.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue and Missions 1–20 in NERO/DANTE/V GAME on @mechanic{Human}.

guide.context: The six NERO/DANTE/V difficulty achievements do not stack, so a higher clear does not award Human.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Human} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME and finish the Prologue plus every numbered mission through Mission 20.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Devil Hunter mode.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue and Missions 1–20 in NERO/DANTE/V GAME on @mechanic{Devil Hunter}.

guide.context: Devil Hunter remains a separate clear even after finishing Human or a harder mode.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Devil Hunter} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME and finish the Prologue plus every numbered mission through Mission 20.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Son of Sparda mode.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue and Missions 1–20 in NERO/DANTE/V GAME on @mechanic{Son of Sparda}.

guide.context: Son of Sparda unlocks after a Human or Devil Hunter clear and grants Dante's Irregular Full Custom.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Son of Sparda} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME and finish the Prologue plus every numbered mission through Mission 20.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Dante Must Die mode.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue and Missions 1–20 in NERO/DANTE/V GAME on @mechanic{Dante Must Die}.

guide.context: Dante Must Die unlocks after Son of Sparda and awards Super costumes plus the last two difficulty modes.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Dante Must Die} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME and finish the Prologue plus every numbered mission through Mission 20.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Heaven or Hell mode.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue and Missions 1–20 in NERO/DANTE/V GAME on @mechanic{Heaven or Hell}.

guide.context: Every enemy and playable character dies in one hit, and each mission grants three lives.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Heaven or Hell} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME and finish the Prologue plus every numbered mission through Mission 20.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Hell and Hell mode.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue and Missions 1–20 in NERO/DANTE/V GAME on @mechanic{Hell and Hell}.

guide.context: The player dies in one hit against Son of Sparda-health enemies; three failed lives restart the mission.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Hell and Hell} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME and finish the Prologue plus every numbered mission through Mission 20.

achievements.description: Clear the Prologue Mission.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Prologue} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Prologue} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Defeat all enemies in Mission 01.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Kill every demon in Mission 01, including the red mantis hidden behind the broken bridge.

guide.context: The hidden mantis guards a Blue Orb Fragment after the midpoint cutscene; all other required enemies stand on the one-way bridge route.

steps.text: Defeat every visible tentacle, flying demon, and ground encounter while advancing through Mission 01.
After dropping from the broken bridge following the cutscene, turn around and kill the red mantis beneath the road before proceeding.
Clear the remaining bridge enemies and complete Mission 01.

achievements.description: Collected Red Orbs from an unexpected spot in Mission 02.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: In Mission 02, enter the high room beside the yellow ambulance and destroy its hidden Red Orb clusters.

guide.context: The left fork continues the story; the right fork immediately after the first fight leads to the achievement room.

steps.text: After Mission 02's first encounter, take the right side of the fork beside the wrecked yellow ambulance.
Jump through the high opening in the building on the right and destroy every Red Orb cluster inside.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 03.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 03} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 03} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Destroy a certain wall in Mission 04.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: In Mission 04's tutorial street, summon @mechanic{Nightmare} to smash the mural-covered wall.

guide.context: The wall is immediately after the collapsed train bridge and warehouse; summoning Nightmare requires three Devil Trigger bars.

steps.text: Enter the street fight after the warehouse and build at least three Devil Trigger bars.
Stand near the large mural of a figure holding a red skull and summon Nightmare; its arrival breaks the building wall.

achievements.description: Fend off a menace from above in Mission 05.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Destroy one Qliphoth tentacle that attacks through the Mission 05 warehouse ceiling.

guide.context: Each ceiling tentacle withdraws after a short interval; the first reliable target appears beside the second Blood Clot.

steps.text: At the warehouse section containing the second Blood Clot, lock onto the ceiling tentacle as soon as it appears.
Focus Shadow and Griffon's attacks on the tentacle until its health reaches zero before it retreats.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 06.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 06} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 06} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 07 with both Nero and V.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear Mission 07 once as Nero and once as V.

guide.context: The two character clears may be recorded on different difficulties and remain credited through Mission Select.

steps.text: Choose Nero for Mission 07 and reach the result screen.
Replay Mission 07 as V and reach the result screen.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 08.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 08} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 08} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Destroy a certain wall in Mission 09.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: After Mission 09's first battle, summon Nightmare to destroy the slab wall above the rocky slope.

guide.context: This is the earliest of Mission 09's two eligible walls, and breaking it opens a shortcut toward Blue Orb Fragment 1 and Secret Mission 6.

steps.text: Keep at least three Devil Trigger bars after the opening Behemoth encounter.
Climb the rocks at the end of the first rocky route, face the slab wall, and summon Nightmare.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 10.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 10} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 10} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Use proper timing to get a leg up in a close-quarters battle against the boss in Mission 11.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Parry @enemy{Cavaliere Angelo} in Mission 11 by striking during the boss's melee swing.

guide.context: A bright flash, brief slow motion, and boss stagger confirm the timed counter. Devil Sword Sparda in Swordmaster or King Cerberus's Revolver supplies long active hit frames.

steps.text: Equip @item{Devil Sword Sparda}, select Swordmaster, and reach the Mission 11 boss.
Use the Swordmaster spinning-sword attack as Cavaliere Angelo's weapon swing reaches Dante; repeat until the flash and stagger occur.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 12.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 12} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 12} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 13 with Nero, V, and Dante.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish Mission 13 once with Nero, once with V, and once with Dante.

guide.context: All three clears persist across difficulty changes, so they can be folded into later campaigns.

steps.text: Use Mission Select to reach Mission 13's result screen with Nero, V, and Dante in separate runs.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 14.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 14} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 14} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Proceed with caution and avoid unneeded damage in Mission 15.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear Mission 15 without taking damage from floor, spike, or traversal traps.

guide.context: Enemy and boss damage does not invalidate the condition. The platform routes at each split are safer than the obvious spike paths.

steps.text: At all three route splits, avoid the spike-lined branches and use the upper platforms or Gerbera aerial route.
Reach and defeat the Mission 15 boss without any environmental trap reducing Nero's health.

achievements.description: Go on the offensive without relying on brute force in the Mission 16 boss battle.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: In Mission 16, stun King Cerberus's next elemental head so the fire–lightning–ice cycle skips that phase.

guide.context: The achievement detects a disrupted head cycle, not a no-Devil-Trigger clear. Fire uses the right head, lightning the left, and ice the middle.

steps.text: Watch which elemental phase @enemy{King Cerberus} is currently using.
Attack the head assigned to the next phase until stars show above it; for example, stun the left lightning head while fire is active.
Continue attacking until King Cerberus changes directly to the following element and the achievement appears.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 17.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 17} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 17} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 18.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Mission 18} in NERO/DANTE/V GAME.

guide.context: This is mandatory campaign progress and can be completed on any available difficulty.

steps.text: Complete every required encounter in @loc{Mission 18} and reach its result screen.

achievements.description: Clear Missions 19 and 20 without using continues (any difficulty except Heaven or Hell).
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear Missions 19 and 20 consecutively without using a continue, outside Heaven or Hell.

guide.context: Returning to Mission Select between the two result screens breaks the consecutive run; Human is the safest eligible difficulty.

steps.text: Start Mission 19 on Human and defeat Vergil without letting Dante's health reach zero.
On the Mission 19 result screen, choose @mechanic{Continue} to enter Mission 20.
Defeat Mission 20's boss without a death or paid/Gold Orb revival.

achievements.description: Perform a Stylish Rank S combo.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Raise the live combat Style rank to S by varying attacks and avoiding damage.

guide.context: Style rises faster when attacks do not repeat; V can command Shadow and Griffon simultaneously while staying out of danger.

steps.text: In Mission 05's first fight as V, alternate Shadow and Griffon attacks, execute weakened enemies with V, and avoid hits until the meter reaches S.

achievements.description: Perform a Stylish Rank SS combo.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Build a varied, damage-free combat string until the live Style rank reaches SS.

guide.context: Longer encounters on Devil Hunter or above give the target enough health for a sustained style chain.

steps.text: Use different attacks, finishers, safe taunts, and Nightmare without taking damage until the meter advances through S to SS.

achievements.description: Perform a Stylish Rank SSS combo.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Build a varied combat string to the live SSS Style rank.

guide.context: V's simultaneous familiar attacks make Mission 05, Mission 07, or Mission 13's respawning arena reliable places to extend the meter.

steps.text: Alternate Shadow and Griffon commands, summon Nightmare, execute weakened demons, and taunt only when safe until the meter displays SSS.

achievements.description: Clear all secret missions.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Discover and clear all 12 Secret Missions hidden across Missions 02–16.

guide.context: A Secret Mission begins only after Dante, Nero, or V stands on its glowing red floor point and faces the matching wall glyph. Once discovered, the challenge remains available from the Main Menu.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 1
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 02 bedroom after the second Nidhogg barrier}
collectibles.method: At Mission 02 bedroom after the second Nidhogg barrier, stand beside the bed and face the exit-wall glyph, then defeat every demon within 1:30.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 2
collectibles.method: At Mission 03 emergency-exit staircase, stand in the bottom alcove and look up at the glyph, then kill every Red Empusa before any escapes underground.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 3
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 04 building behind the two optional Nidhogg barriers}
collectibles.method: At Mission 04 building behind the two optional Nidhogg barriers, climb to the upper broken window, align the outside glyph, and collect every Red Orb before time expires.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 4
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 05 scaffold above the Nightmare-broken warehouse wall}
collectibles.method: At Mission 05 scaffold above the Nightmare-broken warehouse wall, look back from the scaffold's top platform and defeat every enemy without taking damage.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 5
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 08 opening beside the second lava lift}
collectibles.method: At Mission 08 opening beside the second lava lift, use the moving Grim Grips to reach the red point, then traverse the challenge without touching the ground.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 6
collectibles.method: At Mission 09 courtyard behind Nightmare-cleared vines, stand at the far arch facing the entrance glyph, then defeat all demons before the timer ends.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 7
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 10 upper path behind the right timed tooth-gate}
collectibles.method: At Mission 10 upper path behind the right timed tooth-gate, break both Death Scissors blades, then shoot its red face during the exposed instant.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 8
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 11 ruined building after the first Blood Clot moves the clocktower}
collectibles.method: At Mission 11 ruined building after the first Blood Clot moves the clocktower, backtrack to the upper floor, face the entrance glyph, and keep the combat Style rank at S until time expires.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 9
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 12 catacomb stair ledge below the statue}
collectibles.method: At Mission 12 catacomb stair ledge below the statue, use Trickster to reach the rear ledge, face the corridor glyph, and remain airborne until the timer ends.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 10
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 14 space immediately behind the second Blood Clot}
collectibles.method: At Mission 14 space immediately behind the second Blood Clot, align the nearby glyph, then use V's attacks, teleport, and Griffon Glide to land on the goal without touching the ground.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 11
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 15 route behind the first Divinity Statue}
collectibles.method: At Mission 15 route behind the first Divinity Statue, climb the Gerbera/Punch Line ramps to the red point, then reach the challenge goal before time expires.

collectibles.name: Secret Mission 12
collectibles.location: @loc{Mission 16 lower-route alcove above the second large Red Orb tree}
collectibles.method: At Mission 16 lower-route alcove above the second large Red Orb tree, take the downward path after the Behemoth and fire drakes, enter the hidden alcove, then use Dr. Faust 3 in Gunslinger to steal the required Red Orbs.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 enemies in 1 second.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Kill five demons within one second using one area attack.

guide.context: Mission 02's second wave contains exactly five clustered targets and can be retried immediately; Heaven or Hell removes their health preparation.

steps.text: Buy and equip the @item{Helter Skelter} Devil Breaker before Mission 02.
Kill the first three demons, then let the next five group around Nero and weaken them evenly on Human.
Hold Helter Skelter's Break Age attack and release it so all five deaths register within one second.

achievements.description: Wield overwhelming power to exact an unexpected conclusion.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Beat @enemy{Urizen} during the Prologue and unlock the alternate ending.

guide.context: Heaven or Hell turns the normally unwinnable encounter into a one-hit victory; other modes require repeated crystal-shield breaks.

steps.text: Unlock Heaven or Hell by clearing Dante Must Die, then start the Prologue on Heaven or Hell.
Shoot Urizen once to defeat him and remain through the secret-ending transition.

achievements.description: Clear all missions with S rank.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Record an S rank for the Prologue and Missions 1–20, combining difficulties if needed.

guide.context: Only one character S rank is required in Missions 07 and 13. Heaven or Hell with normal costumes makes every enemy die in one hit and is the easiest cleanup route.

steps.text: Select normal costumes and disable Auto-Assist to avoid score penalties.
Use Mission Select to earn an S on every entry from Prologue through Mission 20; check each stored best rank before moving on.

achievements.description: Clear all missions with S rank on all difficulties except Heaven or Hell.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Record S ranks for the entire campaign on five modes: Human and Devil Hunter, then Son of Sparda, Dante Must Die, and Hell and Hell.

guide.context: Heaven or Hell and Vergil Game do not count. Super costumes reduce score by 80%, Auto-Assist by 20%; no checkpoint restart grants 1.2x and no damage grants 2.2x.

steps.text: With normal costumes and Auto-Assist off, record S ranks for all 21 entries on Human, Devil Hunter, Son of Sparda, and Dante Must Die.
Record S ranks for all 21 entries on Hell and Hell, using no-damage routes and avoiding every manual checkpoint restart.
Check Mission Select on each required difficulty and confirm every Prologue/Mission rank is S.

achievements.description: Rack up a total of 60 minutes in the air by jumping or other means.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Accumulate 60 minutes in the air through jumps, glides, and aerial attacks.

guide.context: The cumulative timer includes movement outside combat and carries across characters, missions, and difficulties.

steps.text: Keep jumping and extend aerial combos during normal play until the cumulative airborne timer passes 60 minutes.

achievements.description: Acquire all of Nero's skills.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Purchase every Nero ability in @mechanic{Customize > Skills > Nero}.

guide.context: Nero's complete list costs roughly 4–5 million Red Orbs, including the 3-million-orb Ex Provocation.

steps.text: Farm Red Orbs in Mission 13's final arena or through repeated campaign and Bloody Palace runs.
Open @mechanic{Customize > Skills > Nero} and purchase every remaining entry until the category shows no unowned skills.

achievements.description: Acquire all of Dante's skills.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Unlock Dante's full arsenal and purchase every entry in @mechanic{Customize > Skills > Dante}.

guide.context: Double Kalina Ann has its own unique skill, so Dante's list cannot be completed until the weapon is obtained.

steps.text: Clear Son of Sparda and buy @mechanic{Irregular Full Custom} for 100 Red Orbs.
In Mission 11's three-Blood-Clot ruins, backtrack from the cleared entrance, drop one floor, and take @item{Kalina Ann} from the green table beside the globe.
Reach Mission 18 after collecting Kalina Ann to receive @item{Double Kalina Ann}.
Purchase every ability under @mechanic{Customize > Skills > Dante}, including all weapon-specific entries and Ex Provocation.

achievements.description: Acquire all of V's skills.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Purchase every V ability in @mechanic{Customize > Skills > V}.

guide.context: V's list costs roughly 4–5 million Red Orbs and includes the 3-million-orb Ex Provocation.

steps.text: Accumulate at least 4–5 million Red Orbs through Mission 13 farming, campaigns, or Bloody Palace.
Open @mechanic{Customize > Skills > V} and buy every Shadow, Griffon, Nightmare, movement, and taunt entry.

achievements.description: Upgrade your vitality gauge to max.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Reach 20 vitality segments by obtaining 32 Blue Orb Fragments and purchasing the six shop Blue Orbs.

guide.context: Every four fragments form one full Blue Orb, and each of the 12 Secret Missions supplies one fragment. Purchased full orbs become available from Mission 02.

steps.text: Buy all six @item{Blue Orbs} from @mechanic{Customize > Items} for 1,500, 3,500, 6,000, 9,000, 18,000, and 40,000 Red Orbs.

Mission 01: one field fragment; Mission 02: two field fragments plus Secret Mission 1; Mission 03: two plus Secret Mission 2; Mission 04: two plus Secret Mission 3; Mission 05: one plus Secret Mission 4; Mission 08: two plus Secret Mission 5; Mission 09: two plus Secret Mission 6; Mission 10: one plus Secret Mission 7; Mission 11: one plus Secret Mission 8; Mission 12: one plus Secret Mission 9; Mission 14: one plus Secret Mission 10; Mission 15: two plus Secret Mission 11; Mission 16: one plus Secret Mission 12; Mission 18: one.
Finish the last purchase or pickup and confirm the vitality gauge contains 20 segments.

achievements.description: Upgrade your Devil Trigger Gauge to max.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Collect all eight Purple Orb Fragments and buy all five full Purple Orbs to reach 10 Devil Trigger segments.

guide.context: Every four fragments form one full Purple Orb. The five shop orbs become available from Mission 04 and cost progressively more Red Orbs.

collectibles.name: Five shop Purple Orbs
collectibles.method: Buy the five full Purple Orbs for 3,500, 6,000, 9,000, 18,000, and 40,000 Red Orbs.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 1
collectibles.method: In Mission 04, after the train bridge collapses, collect the fragment placed directly on the story route.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 2
collectibles.method: In Mission 05, after the Empusa Queen, enter the next hall and climb above the doorway you used to enter.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 3
collectibles.method: In Mission 09, in the candlelit catacomb room after the floor drop, summon Nightmare at the left wooden door, clear the ambush, and break the coffins.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 4
collectibles.method: In Mission 10, after the second timed gate's Blue Fragment, enter the cave right of the next white crystal and defeat every demon.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 5
collectibles.method: In Mission 11, collect the visible fragment on the rooftop story path after the burning-drake battle.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 6
collectibles.method: In Mission 12, at the statue room, take the lower Nidhogg path first and enter the room behind the first Blood Sac.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 7
collectibles.method: In Mission 14, after restoring all three pets, break the first right-path Blood Clot, return to the fork, and drop to the hidden platform on the right side of the left path.

collectibles.name: Purple Orb Fragment 8
collectibles.method: In Mission 16, after the Behemoth and two fire drakes, take the downward route and inspect the solid platforms during the descent.

achievements.description: Accept a new job from Morrison after the Red Grave incident.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: During Mission 20's playable credits, defeat more demons than Vergil and remain through Morrison's new-job scene.

guide.context: The job scene requires the bonus ending sequence and can be retried by replaying only Mission 20; skipping the credits forfeits that attempt.

steps.text: After defeating Mission 20's boss, do not skip the credits and kill demons continuously during Nero's and Dante's playable sections.
Defeat more enemies than Vergil until Dante's winning dialogue and both bonus cutscenes play.
Remain through Morrison's post-incident scene until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: Collect more than 1,000,000 Red Orbs total.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Accumulate a lifetime total above 1,000,000 Red Orbs across any game modes.

guide.context: The achievement tracks lifetime collection rather than current wallet balance, so spending orbs does not reduce progress.

steps.text: Collect Red Orb drops and mission rewards through repeated campaigns, Bloody Palace, or Mission 13 farming until the lifetime total exceeds 1,000,000.

achievements.description: Defeat 1,000 enemies total.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Defeat 1,000 demons cumulatively across campaigns and Bloody Palace.

guide.context: Mission 13's final arena can supply endless groups while its Qliphoth nests remain alive.

steps.text: Continue normal campaigns and Bloody Palace, or leave the Mission 13 nests intact and kill their spawns, until 1,000 total demon defeats register.

achievements.description: Collect more than 100 Devil Breakers during missions.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Acquire at least 101 Devil Breaker pickups inside campaign missions.

guide.context: Mission 15 places seven Punch Lines behind its first Divinity Statue, and checkpoint restarts preserve the pickup counter.

steps.text: In Mission 15, reach the first Divinity Statue and enter the optional route behind it.
Collect the seven nearby @item{Punch Line} Devil Breakers, use Break Away to destroy them and free slots, then choose Restart Checkpoint.
Repeat the seven-pickup loop until the cumulative counter passes 100.

achievements.description: Use more than 500,000 Red Orbs total with Dr. Faust.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Spend more than 500,000 Red Orbs through Dante's @item{Dr. Faust} attacks.

guide.context: Dr. Faust unlocks at the start of Mission 13; its level 4 upgrade increases the rate at which attacks spend orbs.

steps.text: Accumulate at least 500,000 Red Orbs, equip Dr. Faust as Dante, and buy Dr. Faust 4 if affordable.
Use Dr. Faust's orb-consuming ranged attacks on enemies until the cumulative expenditure exceeds 500,000.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 11 without equipping a weapon set for Dante (any difficulty except Heaven or Hell).
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: After unlocking Irregular Full Custom, clear Mission 11 as Dante with every melee and ranged weapon set unequipped.

guide.context: Son of Sparda unlocks the customization skill. Royalguard counters can fill Sin Devil Trigger without weapons; Super Dante after Dante Must Die is optional and faster.

steps.text: Clear Son of Sparda, then buy @mechanic{Irregular Full Custom} for 100 Red Orbs.
Before Mission 11, use the equipment customization screen to remove every melee and ranged weapon set from Dante.
On Human or another eligible mode, run past optional encounters, use Royalguard counters and Sin Devil Trigger for mandatory fights, and complete Mission 11.

achievements.description: Beat Mission 07 without any starting Devil Breakers equipped (any difficulty except Heaven or Hell).
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear Mission 07 as Nero after starting with an empty Devil Breaker magazine.

guide.context: Only the starting loadout is restricted; Devil Breakers collected after Mission 07 begins may be equipped and used.

steps.text: Select Nero for Mission 07 and switch the pre-mission Devil Breaker set to the empty magazine.
Begin with zero Devil Breakers and complete Mission 07 outside Heaven or Hell, using any Breakers found inside if desired.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 05 without V's demons getting stalemated (any difficulty except Heaven or Hell).
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear Mission 05 without Shadow or Griffon entering Stalemate.

guide.context: Nightmare immediately restores both familiar health bars. Griffon/Shadow Vigor I–II and Trigger Heart increase the safety margin.

steps.text: Purchase both tiers of @mechanic{Griffon Vigor} and @mechanic{Shadow Vigor}, then add @mechanic{Trigger Heart}.
Play Mission 05 outside Heaven or Hell, watch both familiar health bars, and summon Nightmare whenever either approaches half health.
Defeat the Mission 05 boss and reach the result screen without either familiar becoming Stalemated.

achievements.description: Clear the Bloody Palace with Nero.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear all 101 timed Bloody Palace floors as Nero.

guide.context: Bloody Palace unlocks after the first story clear. Gerbera air dodges and Max-Act help control bosses and flying enemies. Super Nero is allowed for this completion achievement.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Bloody Palace}, choose Nero, and optionally select the Super costume.
Defeat every timed floor and the floor 101 Vergil battle in one completed Nero run.

achievements.description: Clear the Bloody Palace with Dante.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear all 101 timed Bloody Palace floors as Dante.

guide.context: Bloody Palace unlocks after the first story clear. Royalguard plus Dr. Faust/Hat Trick offers a defensive crowd-control route. Super Dante is allowed for this completion achievement.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Bloody Palace}, choose Dante, and optionally select the Super costume.
Defeat every timed floor and the floor 101 Vergil battle in one completed Dante run.

achievements.description: Clear the Bloody Palace with V.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear all 101 timed Bloody Palace floors as V.

guide.context: Bloody Palace unlocks after the first story clear. Stay close enough to heal Shadow and Griffon, and reserve Devil Trigger for Nightmare. Super V is allowed for this completion achievement.

steps.text: Open @mechanic{Bloody Palace}, choose V, and optionally select the Super costume.
Defeat every timed floor and the floor 101 Vergil battle in one completed V run.

achievements.description: Clear all missions as Vergil.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue and Missions 1–20 in VERGIL GAME on any difficulty.

guide.context: Capcom separates Vergil Game achievement credit from NERO/DANTE/V GAME; the Playable Character: Vergil DLC is required on Steam.

steps.text: Switch the title/menu mode to @mechanic{VERGIL GAME}, choose any difficulty, and finish the Prologue plus Missions 1–20 as Vergil.

achievements.description: Acquire all of Vergil's skills.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Purchase every Vergil ability in @mechanic{VERGIL GAME > Customize > Skills}.

guide.context: Vergil's skill inventory and achievement credit are exclusive to VERGIL GAME; campaign and Bloody Palace rewards provide the required Red Orbs.

steps.text: Earn Red Orbs while clearing Vergil Game and Vergil's Bloody Palace.
Open @mechanic{Customize > Skills > Vergil} and purchase every remaining Yamato, Mirage Edge, Beowulf, Doppelganger, movement, and taunt skill.

achievements.description: Clear Mission 19 as Vergil without using any weapons other than Yamato. (Heaven or Hell excluded)
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear VERGIL GAME Mission 19 outside Heaven or Hell while attacking only with @item{Yamato}.

guide.context: Switching to Beowulf or Mirage Edge for any damaging attack invalidates the run; Yamato techniques and a Doppelganger mirroring Yamato remain within the restriction.

steps.text: Start Mission 19 in VERGIL GAME on Human or another eligible difficulty with Yamato selected.
Defeat Dante using only Yamato attacks; do not execute any Beowulf or Mirage Edge attack.
Reach the Mission 19 result screen without continuing into a prohibited weapon attack.

achievements.description: Clear the Bloody Palace as Vergil.
achievements.sortReason: Placed at the first efficient point in the completion route.
achievements.summary: Clear all 101 timed Bloody Palace floors as Vergil.

guide.context: The Playable Character: Vergil DLC is required, and Super Vergil is permitted for this completion achievement.

steps.text: Open Bloody Palace from VERGIL GAME and choose Vergil; select Super Vergil if available.
Defeat every timed floor and the floor 101 boss in one completed Vergil run.
